essence: Every candidate seat of distinction — predicates, objecthood, conceded difference, free-standing being, function — collapses into knower-dependence; the opponent's no-difference is granted, then outflanked from inside (vv1-8).
Grasping-less awareness is declared inert, and the proof turns: only self-reflective consciousness can stand as ground (v9).

sections.SUMMARY: Real and unreal differ nowhere in their own self — the opponent's certainty, stretched to conscious and unconscious. Showing, telling, being: none of it touches own-form, which faces the knower alone. Object-of-showing fits no self, since leaning breaks oneness and oversteps being. The grant costs nothing — appearing's coming and going still serves the end. Being fits only appearing-bound. Function cannot part them either: only existents work, yet working leans on knowers. So all standing is awareness-based. And awareness itself, ungrasping-formed, ranks with non-being and the inert.
sections.FUNCTION: Opens the Siddhitrayī's second proof with the opponent's strongest certainty, then dissolves every candidate seat of distinction from inside — landing awareness-grounded standing and the grasp-less turn.
sections.KEY TERMS: sadasat (real-unreal) · jaḍa/ajaḍa (inert/non-inert) · prakhyā/upākhyā (showing/telling) · jñātṛgāmin (knower-facing) · arthakriyā (working) · pratiṣṭhā (standing) · saṃvidāśrayā (awareness-grounded) · aparāmarśa (ungrasping) · vimarśa kept as grasping against the field's reflective awareness (grounds in NOTE)
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Ajaḍapramātṛsiddhi, Utpaladeva (10th c.), mūla with his own vṛtti; GRETIL KSTS 34. Second proof of the Siddhitrayī. Passage 1 of 3: vv. 1–9. Vṛ read as Utpaladeva's own per the closing colophon (Harabhaṭṭa layer open — see NOTE).
sections.EXPLANATION: The opponent's certainty is granted, then each ground is removed: predicates never touch own-form; objecthood needs another, one form, being; concession still works; being apart from appearing is indeterminate; function marks the scene, not the self; dyed being is borrowed; proven things run level — so standing falls back on awareness. Then the turn: ungrasping awareness ranks inert.
sections.BOUNDARY: Whose end the conceded difference serves stays open. The Vṛ's quietist-Brahman glance recorded, not pressed. GRETIL dental-d quirk in jadājaḍānām read with the editions. adaḥ corrected distal at L0.

rasa.sthayibhava: vismaya (wonder) that awareness itself can rank inert
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is the shock of the turn (v9): after eight verses of demolition, the proof stings its own ground — bare shining is jaḍa. The vyabhicāri is intellectual triumph (vīra) as each candidate dissolves. Abhinava's camatkāra covers dispute-relish: wonder at reasoning that unseats its own seat.
